Hi Team Casa Picolla,

I noticed your property near Patna Super Market on Fraser Road has built strong 4.0★ reviews across 1,300+ guests, but could benefit from an independent direct-booking showcase.

Maine aapke hotel ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct room booking, local landmark directions (opp. Doordarshan Gate), aur photo gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/casapicolla

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Casa Picolla team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke property (Patna Super Market, Fraser Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct mobile room booking, local landmark guidance near Doordarshan Gate, and a clean guest gallery. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact room categories aur direct booking setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
